# Module Map — table-stakes

<!-- generated by /kb-generate — last_crawl_commit: 63ac0159104cfc4373ab7e398c425bf55dfbb984 -->

| Path | Responsibility | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `shared/game-data/` | All balance content as JSON: 8 dishes (with `stationSteps` and an 18-ingredient list), 3 markets, 5 customer segments, 10 events, 11 upgrades, 2 policies, the restaurant layout. | `loader.js` validates the whole catalogue and **fails loudly at boot**. Strict: an ingredient declared but unused, or an event in no market's `eventPool`, is a hard error. |
| `shared/schemas/` | `messages`, `game-state`, `validation`, `setup-rules` — each `.js` + sibling `.d.ts`. | `setup-rules` is imported by both sides: price bands, producibility, and the six §7 qualitative labels. |
| `shared/constants/tuning.js` | Every tunable number, ~40 named blocks by story. | Single source of `THREE_VERSION`. Nothing may inline a constant. |
| `shared/build/three-cdn-external.ts` | Vite plugin keeping `three` external in dev **and** build. | Build tooling, excluded from both app `tsconfig`s. Both vite configs import it — it was once git-ignored and broke a clean clone. |
| `server/src/index.js` | Express + `ws` on one HTTP server; serves the built client. | |
| `server/src/http/` | `/health`, `/api/version`, `/api/markets`, `/api/rooms*`, `/api/dev/match`. | |
| `server/src/websocket/` | `socket-server`, `connection-manager`, `message-router`. | The router rejects a declared-but-unimplemented type with `not_implemented` — never silence. |
| `server/src/game/match.js` | Seed, phase clock, players, reconnect grace, **per-viewer snapshot**. | Contains no gameplay. `toSnapshot(viewer)` serializes `<field> ?? []`, so systems publish by attaching an array. |
| `server/src/game/simulation-loop.js` | `registerSystem()`, the 20 Hz tick and 10 Hz broadcast. | **The seam.** Read its block header before adding a system. |
| `server/src/game/systems/index.js` | The single ordered registration list. | **Order is a documented contract**; each entry says why it sits where it does. |
| `server/src/game/systems/` | `movement`, `setup`, `customers`, `orders`, `events`, `inventory`. | `customer-system.js` (1312 lines) and `order-system.js` (911) are the two big ones. |
| `server/src/game/catalogue.js` | Loads and validates `shared/game-data/` at boot. | |
| `server/src/game/validators/setup-validator.js` | 20 machine-readable rejection reasons. | Pure; only `acceptSetupSubmission` mutates the match. |
| `server/src/game/rng.js` | mulberry32 + `createRngStream(name)`. | **Named sub-streams per system** so one system's draws can't shift another's sequence. |
| `client/src/game/` | `GameClient`, `NetworkClient`, `InputController`, `SceneManager`, `CameraController`, `EntityViewRegistry`, `StateInterpolator`. | The imperative layer, kept out of React's reconciliation path. |
| `client/src/ui/`, `client/src/app/` | `App`, `HudPanel`, `SetupScreen`. | Plain CSS. React re-renders on the low-frequency status callback, never per tick. |
| `client/src/scenes/RestaurantScene.ts` | The scene graph, built from `restaurant-layout.json`. | Contains no networking and no rules — that is what lets harnesses mount it with mocked state. |
| `harnesses/src/` | `harness-shell` (the `SceneHarness` contract) + `restaurant-layout-harness`. | Four of five PRD §15 harnesses are still unbuilt. Runs with no backend. |
| `scripts/` | 9 `check-*.mjs` + 2 `smoke-*.mjs`, chained by `npm run check`. | **This is the test suite** — there is no framework. `lib/server-process.mjs` spawns and kills a server by PID. |
| `openspec/changes/` | Six change directories carrying **42 numbered decisions**. | Cite them by heading. `archive/` is empty; nothing has been archived. |
| `assets/licenses/` | Mandatory metadata for any reused asset. | Currently only a README; no assets yet. |
